[[Pls Donate]] (100 Base Health) |sandbox = No |rewards_increase = +20% }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Base health is capped.|In-Game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''HP Locked''' is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that sets your base health to a specific number. It increases all currency rewards by 20%. '''HP Locked''' appears in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode, [[Polluted Wasteland II]], [[Badlands II]] and [[Pizza Party]]; it is active in all matches on these maps or modes. It also appeared in a few event maps. ==Effects== When active, '''HP Locked''' sets the base health to a specific number, regardless the combined level of all players in a game. The following gamemodes and maps have base health set to 100: *[[Polluted Wasteland II]] *[[A Dark Tale]] *[[The Haunted Past]] *[[Failed Gateway]] *[[The Nightmare Realm]] *[[Containment]] *[[Pls Donate]] The following gamemodes and maps have base health set to 200: *[[Pizza Party]] *[[Badlands II]] *[[Cold Ambush]] *[[Krampus Frosthold]] The following gamemodes and maps have base health set to 500: *[[The Great Finale]] ==Trivia== *Oddly, on the 30th of July 2022 the mention of '''HP Locked''' modifier increasing currency rewards was removed from its in-game description, despite the modifier still increasing them by 20%. *[[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] and [[Molten Mode|Molten]] modes have their base health capped at 200, but this is not through the '''HP Locked''' modifier. **As a result, if the sum of all players' levels does not exceed 100, then the base health will be less than 200. **Base health is not capped in these gamemodes when played through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''4 July 2022''' -
